declarations.name: AuiUploadQueue

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name of the list.

inputs.name: upload
inputs.description: Transport: performs one attempt. Resolve on success (the value becomes item.response), reject on failure, honour signal.

inputs.name: preview
inputs.description: Image previews via object URLs for image/* files (needs img-src blob:).

inputs.name: errorMessage
inputs.description: Map a rejection to a user-facing message. Default: generic localized message.

inputs.name: concurrency
inputs.description: Uploads running at the same time (1..16).

inputs.name: retries
inputs.description: Automatic retries after a failed attempt (0..10).

inputs.name: retryDelay
inputs.description: Delay before the first automatic retry in ms (0..60000); doubles for each further retry.

inputs.name: autoStart
inputs.description: Start uploading as soon as files are added; when false, call start().

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Items were added or removed, or an item changed status (not emitted for progress).

outputs.name: completed
outputs.description: Nothing is queued or uploading any more (once per batch).

properties.name: busy
properties.description: Read-only: Any item queued or uploading.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancel a queued or uploading item (aborts its signal).

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Queue a failed or cancelled item again.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove an item (aborts it; revokes its preview URL).

accessibility.pattern: List of Progress Bars (ARIA progressbar) with native action buttons and a polite live region for outcomes.

limitations: Cancellation is cooperative: the consumer function must pass signal to fetch/XHR. A function that ignores it keeps its concurrency slot until it settles (the item is shown as cancelled immediately).
Retries restart the whole file; resuming from an offset is the consumer function's job (use attempt and id).
Completion is announced once per batch; individual successes are included in the summary rather than announced one by one.
State is not persisted across reloads.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
